dedupe_keys.name: better lbnl os building energy analytics

description: BETTER-LBNL-OS is Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory's current Python analytics library underlying the Building Efficiency Targeting Tool for Energy Retrofits. It fits one-, three- or five-parameter change-point models, benchmarks buildings against peers, estimates weather-normalised savings and produces rule-based efficiency recommendations. Inputs are energy and temperature observations with building or portfolio information; outputs include fitted parameters, quality measures and savings estimates with uncertainty. Coverage is globally configurable and follows the observation period and aggregation chosen by the user. Public source and installation instructions are free under a modified BSD-style licence with DOE rights and an enhancements grant to the licensors. A limitation is that statistical savings and recommendations depend on data quality, peer choice and model validity; they are not guaranteed retrofit outcomes. The library can calibrate building-demand scenarios and complement EnergyPlus (model-energyplus). The superseded LBNL-JCI-ICF/BETTER repository explicitly directs new work here. Both repositories and the current licence were inspected. No building bills, portfolio records or software packages were downloaded.
